verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a REST API, a drag-and-drop editor and automatically generated designs, but nothing showing that EmailOctopus accepts natural-language commands. There is no AI assistant, chat interface or agent integration in the evidence, and probes for llms.txt and an OpenAPI spec returned 404. An API is only a developer building block, and auto-generated designs are an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
